description:
Use this when you need an auditable Ireland national working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need employer, school, bank, sector or individually selected benefit schedules.
What it computes: Counts national working and non-working dates in an Ireland 2026-2027 range.
Example user requests: Count Ireland working days from 2027-01-29 to 2027-02-03.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-01-29","end_date":"2027-02-03","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, holiday_names, calendar_scope, good_friday_policy, weekend_holiday_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += Ireland status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/ireland-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/ireland-working-days-between.md
name: count_ireland_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: National statutory public holidays over a Monday-Friday baseline.

good_friday_policy.description: Good Friday is not a public holiday.

holiday_names.description: National statutory public holidays applying on the date.

non_working_days.description: Weekend and exact national statutory public holiday dates.

public_holidays_counted.description: Exact national events in the range.

sources.description: Official Irish government regulator and legislation sources.

weekend_holiday_policy.description: No automatic next-working-day closure is inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Ireland Working Days
